name: Vegetation
overview: Russia, the near future. The Urals has turned into a forest area full of dangers and mysteries. People extract valuable fuel from it, and hunters risk their lives for the sake of rare trees, on which the development of technology and entire states depends. Official brigades and illegal immigrants join the struggle for power and money, and in the very heart of the conflict are two twin brothers, whose expedition will change the state of things in this forest.
